# 1.2.44 - the audit's task list, worked through

The eleven tasks the 1.2.42 audit left on the table, done in order. No new
feature; the same game, with the seams the audit found sewn shut. The copy is
still the copy - its rewording comes with 1.3.0.

**What only the right people see.** The murder's last leaks are closed: the
cards the incident posts to one person carry a neutral speaker and reach the
whole table as an empty stub, with the words travelling to their reader alone;
the betrayal offer and the weapon that was swung live in the GM's cast and not
on the actor. Messenger threads are the same kind of private card now, so a
player's console holds nothing of another player's thread. A token walking into
your room appears when its sprite crosses the border, not where it started, and
the "not connected" refusal names only rooms you have been in.

**One channel to the GM.** Every ruling a player waits on - a Hope Call, a
Dynamic threshold, an item's creative use, a Monocub's meddling - arrives as a
card with buttons, in the thread, and every refusal reaches the player who
asked. Nothing is charged until the GM says yes; a request that gets no answer
is refunded and says so in the player's language.

**Rules that were being broken quietly.** A Reroll replays the action it undoes
by that action's own rules (the Search trace, the tool's relief, the statistic
that was actually rolled). Bedrooms come from the map's regions; a stashed item
cannot be handed over; a project's traps go with the project; a murder project
without a named killer is refused. Under a darkening no Call may grant Hope,
and one GM writes the pools so two GMs cannot race them. The vote counts the
ballots it issued. A chapter cannot be ended twice.

**Cheaper.** A clock write is one HUD rebuild instead of four; the fog stops
re-reading styles and rebuilding a rectangle sixty times a second; chat cards
read their colours once a second instead of once per card; the sheet's resize
observer dies with the sheet.

**Smaller things you will notice.** Observe with nothing to find no longer opens
a second window. Sabotage picks its target in the Projects window. The safeword
has a door for everyone: `game.drpg.safeword()` and a keybinding under Controls.
The minutes counter freezes with the hour it sits under during an incident. The
End of chapter screen knows chapter six is the last. A fresh world no longer
inherits the language file's in-joke as its safeword. Accent-coloured words on
the glass are readable at Night and in a trial; nothing on Legacy sits under the
eleven-pixel floor.

**Handbooks.** `docs/handbooks/` carries the one-page student brochure, the
Player Handbook and the GM Handbook, each in English and Polish.
